title: Stage 8 auto-populate on first entry (inherit then populate, or populate only for scene 1)

notes: If inherit throws, populate is skipped in the same try block. Inherit route returns 400 when instances exist, so reruns depend on the empty-list check.
preconditions: sceneAssets empty, not isLoading, scenes loaded, stage8 not locked or outdated, autoPopulateAttempted false
code_path: Stage8VisualDefinition.tsx:240-272 -> sceneAssetService.inheritAssets -> R4 -> AssetInheritanceService.inheritAssetsFromPriorScene; populateFromDependencies -> R14

title: Inherit button (manual re-run of inheritance)
summary: Button in the scene asset list calls inherit. Backend refuses if the scene already has any instance, so it only works on an empty scene.
notes: Error toast shows the backend 400 text.
code_path: SceneAssetListPanel onInherit -> sceneAssetService.inheritAssets -> POST .../assets/inherit -> AssetInheritanceService

title: Deterministic populate from scene expected_characters/location/props
summary: Name-matches scenes.expected_* (case-insensitive) against all project_assets on the active branch and inserts instances with carry_forward=true, status_tags=[], effective_description=asset.description, no image. No LLM.
notes: Does not filter project_assets by locked (unlike bootstrap and relevance). Only called from auto-populate; handleDetectAndPopulateAssets which also calls it is dead.

summary: Detect with AI calls relevance (LLM) then creates one instance per relevant asset with starting_description as override and status_tags_inherited, and saves new_assets_required as suggestions. Any 409 in Promise.all rejects the whole batch.
notes: Re-running after an asset is present yields 409 for that asset, so the batch rejects and suggestions are skipped. Instances are created without image.
preconditions: scene on active branch; locked branch project_assets exist
code_path: handleAIDetectAssets -> detectRelevantAssets -> llmClient -> createSceneAsset xN -> saveSuggestions
downstream: instances start without image so Proceed gatekeeper blocks

title: Add existing project asset to scene from AssetDrawer (with optional shot checklist)
summary: Drawer lists project or global assets; selecting one creates the instance (no description, no image) and, if shots exist, shot_asset_assignments with presenceType throughout for chosen shots.

summary: Inline form creates a locked:true, source:manual project_asset with scene_numbers=[n] and an instance with description_override=effective_description=typed text; compensating delete of the asset if the instance insert fails.

title: Tag carry-forward prompt on entering a scene with inherited tags

summary: Lock Asset button adds the string 'locked' to status_tags. The editor then disables the description, infer, add-transformation and tag editing controls. There is no unlock control in the UI.

title: Generate single scene asset image (async job, polled)
summary: Generate Image enqueues a scene_asset image job built from effective_description, status-tag modifiers and isolation text. The client polls the job every 2s for up to 120s, then refetches attempts and instances. On completion the backend creates a selected generated attempt and sets image_key_url.
notes: Reference image is the client's image_key_url only when Use as ref is on; otherwise selected_master_reference_url, then project image. Idempotency key includes Date.now so there is no dedupe. Job may complete after the 120s client timeout.
preconditions: Stage 5 visual style or manual tone present; instance not use_master_as_is
code_path: handleGenerateImage -> sceneAssetService.generateSceneAssetImage -> POST generate-image -> ImageGenerationService.createSceneAssetImageJob -> createImageJob -> executeJobInBackground -> NanoBanana -> storage -> attempts + instance

summary: Generate (n) opens a cost modal with a hardcoded 1 credit per image, then fires one generate-image request per selected instance and polls all jobs.
notes: Does not skip use_master_as_is instances, so a generated attempt becomes selected while the master flag stays true. Failed generate requests are reported as failed statuses with empty jobId.
code_path: handleBulkGenerateClick -> cost modal -> handleBulkGenerateConfirmed -> bulkGenerateImages (Promise.allSettled of R5) -> pollBulkImageJobs

title: Attempt carousel: browse, select, delete image attempts
summary: Carousel lists all attempts (backfilling one if none exist). Select sets is_selected and copies its url to image_key_url. Delete is allowed only for non-selected attempts and removes storage when storage_path exists.

Then the AddTransformation dialog creates an event on the base, copies absorbed image as post image, and deletes the absorbed instance. Optional toast action defers the project asset.
notes: Absorbed instance is deleted, cascading its attempts and assignments. Trigger inference from absorbed shot assignments is in the backend prefill; the dialog uses the returned trigger in place of the shots[0] fallback when provided.

summary: Event cards list each event. Confirm (requires non-empty post description) sets confirmed; Dismiss or Delete removes the row. Blur saves post_description or narrative. Generate with AI overwrites post_description server-side.

On completion the backend writes post_image_key_url and the frontend writes the same value again. Use Existing lists confirmed post images of the same project asset across scenes.

preconditions: none (button always rendered when onComplete set)
code_path: handleProceedToStage9 -> handleSceneStageComplete -> sceneStageLockService.lockStage -> sceneStageLocks route

summary: Confirmed events are resolved per shot into overrides (pre, instant post, within_shot transforming, gradual completion) used by frame and prompt generation for the same scene.
notes: Computed at generation time, nothing stored. Gradual with NULL completion never reaches post. Other slices own prompt and frame wiring.
entrypoint: frame generation and prompt generation routes
preconditions: confirmed events exist for the scene
code_path: getTransformationEventsForScene -> filter confirmed -> resolveOverridesForShot -> shotOverrides -> prompt/frame builders

summary: Shot extraction asks the LLM for transformation_flags and the projects route stores them as JSON on shots. No code converts them to transformation_events.
notes: Test exercises a copy of the parser, not the real service.

title: Scene description triplet: description_override vs effective_description vs version history
summary: description_override is user or inherited text. effective_description is a stored snapshot recomputed only on PUT with descriptionOverride, and by create paths. Version write-back changes only description_override, so the two can diverge if the follow-up PUT fails.
notes: Empty string is kept (?? does not coalesce empty). Downstream consumers read effective_description.

side_effects: effective_description recomputed; text_field_versions row; description_override written

title: Attempt selection: exactly one selected attempt per instance, mirrored to image_key_url
summary: Partial unique index allows one is_selected per instance. Selecting, uploading, generating, use-master and backfill each deselect old and set new, then copy url to image_key_url. Select route writes image_key_url separately, so a failure can leave them inconsistent.
notes: Selecting deselects then selects in sequence, so a mid-step failure leaves zero selected.
trigger: select attempt; generation completion; upload; use-master
side_effects: previous selection cleared; image_key_url set; modification_count incremented by trigger
invalidates: reference chain entries that used prior selected url
ui_signal: Selected badge and amber border in carousel

title: use_master_as_is flag and its image side effect
summary: Enabling sets flag true, image_key_url to master url, and inserts master_copy attempt. Disabling only clears the flag. Upload clears the flag. select-master-reference clears it.
notes: Disable branch unreachable in UI.
precondition: master url available (selected reference or project image)
invalidates: generation and upload controls disabled while true
ui_signal: Master badge in list, disabled generate/upload

title: Selected master reference (selected_master_reference_* triple)
summary: Set only by select-master-reference; read as default generation reference and by context builders. Instance FK set null on instance delete. Source check constraint allows stage5_master, prior_scene_instance, transformation.
notes: No verification that url is in chain.
side_effects: use_master_as_is set false; generate default reference changes

title: 'locked' sentinel status tag
summary: Lock Asset appends the string locked to status_tags. It disables several editor controls and is used by list badges and an unused reviewStatus helper. It is not checked by backend routes.
notes: Carried forward and included in image prompts.
side_effects: tag appended; controls disabled; tag persists to prompts and next scene

title: Transformation event lifecycle: unconfirmed -> confirmed (irreversible in UI)
summary: Events are created unconfirmed (manual) and only confirmed events affect resolution, inheritance, reference chain and frame prompts. Confirm stamps confirmed_at. No un-confirm route exists.
notes: Confirmation requires non-empty post_description in UI only; backend does not check.
side_effects: confirmed=true, confirmed_at set; event enters resolution and inheritance
invalidates: prior inheritance for later scenes only when re-inherited
ui_signal: green card, Confirmed label, post-image section appears

title: modification_count and last_modified_field audit trigger
summary: Trigger increments modification_count on every UPDATE to scene_asset_instances, including image job completion, attempt select and inherit-created rows. last_modified_field set only for four columns.
notes: Counts are not a human audit trail. Badge computed from count.
ui_signal: Audit trail section and list status badge

title: Scene asset suggestion accepted/dismissed flags
summary: Suggestions are inserted unaccepted. Only dismissed is ever written, from Ignore. accepted is never written. Non-dismissed rows are displayed.
notes: Accepted state unused.

title: Tag carry-forward prompt suppression (browser-only state)
summary: Prompt is suppressed per scene via localStorage key tag-prompt-<sceneId>, set on confirm or close. Not server-side, so other browsers still see it.
notes: Survives reloads in same browser only.
trigger: confirm or close of tag prompt

title: Inheritance flows only from scene N-1 by scene_number; reset when prior carry_forward is false
summary: Inherit creates one instance per prior-scene instance, copying override, image, tags and carry_forward. Assets absent from N-1 are not inherited. If prior carry_forward is false, the copy is reset to master image, no override, no tags.
notes: Relevance prompt uses non-linear last-appearance context, which contradicts the strict N-1 description in the service header only for the AI path.
trigger: inherit route or auto-populate on scene with zero instances
precondition: scene_number > 1 and N-1 exists; otherwise bootstrap for scene 1

title: Inheritance and populate copy values at creation; no later propagation
summary: No code updates a scene instance when the prior instance, the project asset, or scene text changes. Only explicit PUT, versions, generation and upload change instance state.
notes: Reference chain is read live, so prior scene edits show there.
trigger: project asset edit; prior instance edit; scene text re-extraction

title: Project asset description edits do not propagate into effective_description
summary: effective_description snapshots the master description at creation, and is only recomputed from the master when PUT includes descriptionOverride. Stage 5 edits leave it stale.
notes: No staleness flag exists.

title: Generation attempt cap of 8 per instance (oldest non-selected deleted)
summary: Before any new attempt (generate, upload, use-master, edit), when count >= 8 the oldest non-selected attempt and its storage object are deleted. Selected attempt is never deleted.
notes: Count check is not transactional; concurrent generates may exceed the cap.

title: Description version cap 8 and write-back to shots/instances
summary: text_field_versions keeps max 8 per entity and field; the selected version is written back to the source column. Backfill creates v1 from existing content with source ai_generation.
notes: Test replicates constants rather than importing service.
trigger: create, select, or first list call

title: Only confirmed transformation events affect resolution; unconfirmed are ignored
summary: resolveOverridesForShot skips unconfirmed events. The reference chain, inheritance, transformation images and frame and prompt context all filter confirmed=true.
notes: Stage 8 gatekeeper counts unconfirmed separately.

title: Deleting scene or instance cascades to dependent rows
summary: FKs cascade: deleting an instance removes its attempts, transformation events and shot assignments. Deleting a shot removes events where it is the trigger (completion set null). Deleting a project asset removes instances.
notes: Scene re-extraction deletes unmatched scenes (cross-slice).
trigger: DELETE instance, shot, scene, or project asset

title: Proceed requires images on all instances and no unresolved transformations (client-enforced only)
summary: The gate is enforced in the frontend only. Backend stage-lock route does not check Stage 8 content.
notes: Transformation counts come from a React Query key the local list does not invalidate.
precondition: sceneAssets and transformation query data loaded

title: Transformation post state is inherited as the prior instance's final state
summary: When the prior scene's instance has confirmed events, the last event by trigger shot_order supplies description, tags (post_status_tags, always empty from UI) and image for the next scene's inherited instance. Same logic feeds relevance context.
notes: Inheritance order uses only the prior scene, not all earlier scenes.

title: AI detect all-or-nothing batch on instance creation
summary: Detect creates instances with Promise.all. A duplicate returns 409 and rejects the batch, leaving partial creates and skipping suggestion save.
notes: Partial writes possible because Promise.all does not roll back.
precondition: some relevant asset already in scene

title: Relevance detection (which assets appear in scene, starting state)
summary: Detect-relevance sends shot list, last known state per asset from earlier scenes and locked branch assets to the LLM, asking for JSON with relevant_assets and new_assets_required. Parsed by regex and filtered to valid ids.
notes: Output written only via client calls to create instances and suggestions.
model: GEMINI_MODEL env, default gemini-1.5-flash in generate(); constructor default gemini-2.5-flash-lite
context_inputs: scenes.script_excerpt, scene_number; shots shot_id characters_foreground setting action; prior-scene last instance effective_description and status_tags; locked project_assets id name type description
output_parse: regex first {...} block, JSON.parse, filter relevant_assets by valid ids; throws on failure (500)
retry_fallback: llmClient exponential retry on retryable errors; no fallback
persistence: none directly; client persists via R3 and R11
trigger: Detect with AI button or detect route

title: Single-asset story context inference
summary: Infer from Story sends one asset with master and current description and tags, plus scene context, to produce suggested_description, suggested_tags, reasoning.
notes: Treatment context likely empty (keys mismatch). Parser tested only via replicated copy.
context_inputs: asset name type master description effective description tags; scene script_excerpt; all locked stage 3 beats; treatmentProse or stage 2 selected treatment (first 2000 chars); shot action/dialogue/setting/characters
output_parse: regex JSON, fields suggested_description, suggested_tags, reasoning; throws on parse failure
retry_fallback: llmClient retry; error bubbles to 500 and toast

title: Bulk story context inference (batched or parallel)
summary: Bulk infer sends up to 50 instance ids. For 4 or fewer, one batched call returns results array keyed by instanceId; more than 4 runs parallel single calls, capturing per-asset errors into reasoning.
notes: Batched output mapping relies on model echoing instanceId.
context_inputs: script excerpt; beats; treatment; shot actions; per asset name type id master desc current desc tags
output_parse: regex JSON with results array; throws if not array; missing ids yield empty suggestion
retry_fallback: per-asset parallel path catches errors into reasoning; batched path has no fallback

title: Generate post-transformation description
summary: Asks LLM for a post-transformation visual description from pre description, narrative and scene excerpt; truncated to 500 characters and persisted to post_description.
notes: Frontend card textarea is not synced to the persisted value.
context_inputs: asset name; pre_description; narrative (or fallback text); scene script_excerpt
trigger: Generate with AI on unconfirmed card

title: Transformation prefill (post description, narrative, optional inferred trigger and type)
summary: Prefill sends trigger shot fields, asset current appearance, transformation type label, scene excerpt and optional absorbed asset description, and expects JSON with post_description and transformation_narrative. Absorbed mode infers trigger and type from its shot assignments.
notes: Fence stripped; non-JSON falls back to raw text as post_description.
context_inputs: trigger shot action dialogue setting camera characters; instance effective description; scene excerpt 800 chars; absorbed instance description and shot assignments
output_parse: fence strip then JSON.parse; catch uses raw text; substring 500 each
retry_fallback: raw content used as post_description on parse failure
persistence: none; UI fills dialog then createEvent
trigger: trigger shot or type change in AddTransformationDialog; Convert flow next

title: Scene asset and transformation image generation (image model)
summary: Image jobs send prompt (effective description plus visual modifiers, or post description plus post tags) and reference images to the image model. The output is stored and linked to instance or event. Isolation suffix is injected for scene_asset on isolatable types.
notes: Transformation post prompt does not receive isolation suffix despite being an image job; ImageGenerationService.postProcessBackground is a no-op.
user_prompt_src: ImageGenerationService.ts:219-226 effective_description plus Visual modifiers plus isolation suffix
context_inputs: effective_description, status_tags, asset_type, reference image priority (client, selected master reference, project image), visual style capsule or manual tone
output_parse: artifact to buffer, storage upload, public URL
retry_fallback: job failed state with failure_stage; no retry
persistence: storage asset-images; attempts; instance image_key_url; or transformation post_image_key_url
trigger: Generate Image, bulk generate, edit-image, generate-post-image

title: Uploaded image vision description extraction
summary: Upload analysis sends the stored image to Gemini vision with a type-specific prompt and returns a 2-4 sentence visual description with a length-based confidence.
notes: Image is re-downloaded from its URL.
context_inputs: image bytes; asset type; asset name; existing description (used only for merge)
output_parse: text trim; confidence = 0.9, 0.7 or 0.5 by length
retry_fallback: none; route error is non-blocking in UI

title: Merge existing and extracted descriptions
summary: When an existing description is present, a second Gemini call merges it with the extracted description into one 2-4 sentence text shown in the upload modal.
notes: Merge is not generated when the existing description is empty.
context_inputs: existing description; extracted description; asset type; name

title: Migrations defining the slice schema
summary: 015 creates scene_asset_instances; 016, 026, 032 extend image job types; 017 adds modification tracking; 022 creates attempts and master-reference columns; 024 suggestions; 030 transformation_events and shots.transformation_flags; 036 text_field_versions; 037 adds transformation to master reference source.
